title: Procore Technologies, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Procore Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026 (event date April 20, 2026) announcing the appointment of Dr. Vishal Misra as an independent director to its Board of Directors, increasing board membership from 10 to 11. Dr. Misra was also appointed to the Audit Committee. This is a standard corporate governance filing under SEC Item 5.02.
key_points: Procore Technologies, Inc. Board of Directors increased from 10 to 11 members on April 20, 2026.
Dr. Vishal Misra appointed as new independent Class III director, serving until the 2027 annual meeting.
Dr. Misra appointed to the Audit Committee; qualifies as independent under NYSE listing standards.
Annual cash retainer: $48,100 for Board service, additional $13,500 for Audit Committee.
Initial RSU award of $530,000 granted, vesting in three equal annual installments (Feb 2027, 2028, 2029).
Press release announcing appointment issued April 22, 2026, filed as Exhibit 99.1.
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance filing. The appointment of an independent director with technology/analytics expertise (Dr. Misra) may have minor implications for Procore's strategic direction given the company's construction management software focus, but has no relevance to broader market structure or macro catalysts.
